correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the 14-vertex cyclic complex from the six specified difference cycles, obtaining 77 tetrahedra, face vector (14,91,154,77), 210 missing triangles. On boundary matrices over F3, rank d1=13 and rank d2=77 give H1 dimension 1. The explicit alternating 1-cochain w(i,j)=(-1)^i q_{j-i}, q=(1,0,1,1,0,1,0,2,0,2,1,0,1), is antisymmetric, vanishes on all 154 filled triangles, detects (0,1,4); independent enumeration reproduces empty-triangle class counts 28 zero, 91 each nonzero class. Cyclic shifts give 15 orbits of size 14: 2 null gap types (1,5,8),(3,6,5), 13 essential, total 182; one-step shift negates the cocycle. Every simple cycle has >=3 edges, so all 182 detected triangles realize the mod-3 homology systole 3. Finite exhaustive domain is exactly this named complex, not a claim for all lens-space triangulations; topological identification L(3,1) is from Spreer.
